title: Extension Area Specialized Agent for Farm Innovation and Agribusiness Management - Northwest
description:
Job Description

The Area Specialized Extension Agent (ASA) for Farm Innovation and
Agribusiness Management is responsible for providing leadership,
guidance, and expertise to producers, Extension agents, and the
agricultural community in Virginia Cooperative Extension’s (VCE)
Northwest District. The position’s home office location may be a
unit office within the district or based at the Northwest District
Office of VCE in Mt. Crawford, VA. The position will provide
services throughout the 20 counties and independent cities within
the district.
As producers face increasingly complex decisions about land use,
technology adoption, new crops, new nutrients, and the processes
for using them, many find they need tools and access to faculty to
support quality decision-making. The position will further economic
and business decision-making (i.e., enterprise budgets, profit/loss
analysis, financial crisis management, farm labor, economics of
improvements, land lease rates, etc.). The ASA will be expected to
evaluate the economic efficacy of new technologies and the
technology’s ability to contribute to the profitability and
sustainability of producer operations in their unique
contexts.
This position will play a key role in enhancing agricultural
sustainability, economic viability, and community well-being to the
area farming communities. The ASA will work closely with Extension
agents and specialists in delivering educational programming that
enhances the agricultural productivity and sustainability of
producer operations, with specific emphasis on livestock
production.

Required Qualifications

A master’s degree in agricultural economics or a related
discipline. Strong knowledge of applied agricultural economics,
livestock production, and agricultural technology. Excellent oral
and written communication skills. Experience working
collaboratively with a wide variety of stakeholders, including
businesses, community organizations, and/or Extension agents and
staff. Demonstrated ability to plan, implement, facilitate, teach,
and evaluate educational programs. Knowledge and use of computer
technology in educational programming and management. Strong
presentation skills. Able to work independently and as part of a
team. Strong desire to help clients succeed.

The person in the position is expected to travel to provide
in-person leadership and to build community partnerships with few
exceptions for telework.

Virginia Tech is unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for
this vacancy.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong knowledge of livestock, agronomy and local cropping systems.
Prior experience as an Extension agent.

Overtime Status

Exempt: Not eligible for overtime

Appointment Type

Regular

Salary Information

$70,000 - $90,000

Hours per week

40

Close Date

October 16, 2026

Additional Information

The successful candidate will be required to have a driver's
license check with an acceptable and safe driving record.

The successful candidate will be required to have a criminal
conviction check.

About Virginia Tech

Dedicated to its motto, Ut Prosim (That I May Serve),
Virginia Tech pushes the boundaries of knowledge by taking a
hands-on, transdisciplinary approach to preparing scholars to be
leaders and problem-solvers. A comprehensive land-grant institution
that enhances the quality of life in Virginia and throughout the
world, Virginia Tech is an 
inclusive community dedicated to knowledge, discovery, and
creativity. The university offers more than 280 majors to a diverse
enrollment of more than 36,000 undergraduate, graduate, and
professional students in eight 
undergraduate colleges , a 
school of medicine , a 
veterinary medicine college, 
Graduate School , and 
Honors College . The university has a significant presence
across Virginia, including Blacksburg, the greater Washington, D.C.
area, the Health Sciences and Technology Campus in Roanoke, sites
in Newport News and Richmond, and numerous 
Extension offices and 
research institutes . A leading global research institution,
Virginia Tech conducts more than $650 million in research
annually.

Virginia Tech endorses and encourages participation in professional
